Name: Binning Skill Retexture for Gwen's Craftables
Author: arachnida
Description:
Hi!

I've made a Compatibility Patch for Gwen's Craftables!
All sprites are straight from Gwen, so all credits to her. All I've done is some patching up and modification of her assets to match the Binning Skill assets.

There's also a Grandpa's Tools patch, that uses her Patched, Restored, Reinforced and Masterwork Garbage cans instead of the colored ones.

This mod doesn't do anything on its own, its just a visual assets mod. To install, all you have to do is choose a version from the Downloads Tab and unzip it in your mods folder; when it asks to replace the files, just check yes. The retextures will work as intended.
